ingredients.plainExplanation: Wholesome dairy milk standardized to a consistent ratio of milk fat and solids-not-fat (SNF).
ingredients.whyUsed: Provides core nutrition, protein structure, and natural dairy taste.
ingredients.consumerNote: Naturally rich in bioavailable calcium, riboflavin (B2), and complete proteins containing all essential amino acids.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Complies with FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations 2011, Regulation 2.1.1.

ingredients.plainExplanation: Refined disaccharide derived from sugarcane or sugar beets.
ingredients.whyUsed: Imparts immediate sweetness, contributes to browning, and acts as a humectant.
ingredients.consumerNote: Rapidly digested simple carbohydrate. ICMR-NIN and WHO recommend limiting total added sugars to under 10% of daily energy (~50g/day).
ingredients.fssaiNote: Regulated under FSSAI Standards for Sugar and Confectionery (Regulation 2.8.1).

ingredients.plainExplanation: A thick, viscous syrup manufactured by hydrolyzing starch into glucose molecules.
ingredients.whyUsed: Prevents crystallization in confectionery and provides smooth chewiness and texture.
ingredients.consumerNote: High glycemic index simple sugar that quickly elevates blood glucose levels.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Conforms to FSSAI Regulation 2.8.1 specifications for Liquid Glucose.

ingredients.plainExplanation: An equimolar mixture of glucose and fructose produced by splitting sucrose.
ingredients.whyUsed: Sweeter than regular sucrose, retains moisture, and prolongs shelf freshness in baked goods.
ingredients.consumerNote: Counted as an added free sugar source by international health authorities.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Permitted sweetening agent under FSSAI regulations.

ingredients.plainExplanation: Traditional unrefined sugar made from evaporating raw sugarcane juice.
ingredients.whyUsed: Provides caramel-like sweetness and earthy flavour.
ingredients.consumerNote: Contains trace minerals (iron, potassium) from the cane juice, but remains predominantly sucrose (65-85%) and counts as free sugar.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Specified under FSSAI Standards for Gur/Jaggery (Regulation 2.8.4).

ingredients.plainExplanation: A complex carbohydrate powder made by partially breaking down grain or tuber starch.
ingredients.whyUsed: Acts as a carrier for seasonings, improves mouthfeel, and adds bulk without cloying sweetness.
ingredients.consumerNote: Starch-derived carbohydrate. Although not legally classified as a conventional simple sugar on Indian food labels, it possesses a high glycemic index (85-105) and is rapidly absorbed.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Recognized and permitted food additive/bulking agent under FSSAI regulations.

ingredients.plainExplanation: Vegetable lipid extracted from the pulp of oil palm fruits.
ingredients.whyUsed: Extremely heat-stable for industrial frying, resists oxidation/rancidity, and is semi-solid at room temperature.
ingredients.consumerNote: Naturally contains approximately 45-50% saturated fatty acids (mainly palmitic acid). Moderation is advised under WHO cardiovascular guidelines.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Complies with FSSAI Standards for Edible Vegetable Oils (Regulation 2.2.1).

ingredients.plainExplanation: Endosperm of wheat kernels ground into fine flour after removing the bran and germ layers.
ingredients.whyUsed: Develops a light, elastic gluten network for fluffy bakery textures and crisp snacks.
ingredients.consumerNote: Refining strips away the bran's dietary fibre and germ micronutrients. Contains gluten.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Meets FSSAI standards under Regulation 2.4.2 (Maida).

ingredients.plainExplanation: Coarsely or finely ground whole wheat grain containing intact bran, germ, and starchy endosperm.
ingredients.whyUsed: Wholesome baking and flatbread dough base.
ingredients.consumerNote: Rich in insoluble dietary fibre, B vitamins, and trace minerals. Contains gluten.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Conforms to FSSAI Atta standards (Regulation 2.4.1).

ingredients.plainExplanation: Purified crystalline mineral predominantly composed of sodium chloride.
ingredients.whyUsed: Enhances food flavours, suppresses bitterness, and controls microbial shelf stability.
ingredients.consumerNote: 1 gram of salt contains approx. 400 mg of sodium. WHO advises keeping daily sodium below 2,000 mg (<5g salt).
ingredients.fssaiNote: Mandated to be fortified with potassium iodate in India under FSSAI Regulation 2.4.11.

ingredients.plainExplanation: A natural mixture of phospholipids extracted from non-GMO soy or sunflower seeds.
ingredients.whyUsed: Allows smooth blending of water and oils in chocolates and dressings without separating.
ingredients.consumerNote: A naturally occurring fat component with no adverse health effects in typical food quantities. If derived from soy, sensitive individuals should note potential soy allergenicity.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Permitted food additive under FSSAI Food Additives Regulation (Appendix A, Table 1).

ingredients.plainExplanation: An organic acid naturally present in citrus fruits, commercially fermented from carbohydrate sources.
ingredients.whyUsed: Imparts a clean, tart citrus taste and maintains optimal pH to inhibit spoilage microbes.
ingredients.consumerNote: Naturally metabolized via the human Krebs citric acid cycle. Non-toxic and safe at customary dietary levels.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Permitted as GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) acidity regulator under FSSAI Appendix A.

ingredients.plainExplanation: Pure mineral compound that releases carbon dioxide bubbles when heated or combined with acid.
ingredients.whyUsed: Expands batter to produce light, airy textures in biscuits and cakes.
ingredients.consumerNote: Contains sodium (approx. 27% by weight), which contributes modestly to total sodium load in baked goods.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Authorized GMP leavening additive under FSSAI regulations.

ingredients.plainExplanation: A traditional baker's salt that completely decomposes into gaseous ammonia and carbon dioxide during baking.
ingredients.whyUsed: Produces an ultra-crisp, snappy crumb in thin biscuits and crackers without leaving residual saltiness.
ingredients.consumerNote: Gases evaporate entirely in the oven; no residual ammonia remains in the finished baked product.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Approved GMP raising agent under FSSAI regulations.

ingredients.plainExplanation: The sodium salt of glutamic acid, an amino acid naturally abundant in tomatoes, mushrooms, and aged cheese.
ingredients.whyUsed: Activates the tongue's umami taste receptors to create rich, savory satisfaction.
ingredients.consumerNote: Contains approximately one-third the sodium of table salt. Scientific consensus (WHO, US FDA, EFSA) confirms safety for general consumption; individuals with specific sensitivity should heed label declarations.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Permitted under FSSAI regulations with required labelling declaration 'Contains Added Monosodium Glutamate'.

ingredients.plainExplanation: A nucleotide sodium salt derived from yeast or tapioca starch.
ingredients.whyUsed: Acts synergistically with MSG to amplify savory umami sensations by up to eightfold.
ingredients.consumerNote: Metabolized into purines; individuals on low-purine diets for gout are advised to monitor intake.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Permitted food additive under FSSAI Food Additives Schedule.

ingredients.plainExplanation: A natural nucleotide salt that works in synergy with MSG and disodium guanylate.
ingredients.whyUsed: Deepens round, savory mouthfeel in soups, noodles, and savory seasoning mixes.
ingredients.consumerNote: Typically paired with INS 627 (known as I+G). Safe at customary dietary levels.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Permitted under FSSAI Food Additives Schedule.

ingredients.plainExplanation: A synthetic phenolic antioxidant designed to protect fats from reacting with oxygen.
ingredients.whyUsed: Prevents frying oils and snack fats from turning rancid, extending product shelf life.
ingredients.consumerNote: Subject to strict regulatory limits in packaged foods. FSSAI and WHO/JECFA have established an Acceptable Daily Intake (ADI) of 0-0.7 mg/kg body weight.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Permitted in edible vegetable oils and fats up to a maximum limit of 200 ppm under FSSAI regulations.

ingredients.plainExplanation: Water-soluble dark brown food colouring produced by heating carbohydrates in the presence of sulfite and ammonium compounds.
ingredients.whyUsed: Gives colas, sauces, and confectionery their characteristic deep mahogany-brown hue.
ingredients.consumerNote: The most widely used food colour in beverages. Toxicological evaluations by JECFA and EFSA consider it safe within specified ADI limits.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Permitted synthetic food colour under FSSAI Regulation 2.1.2.

ingredients.plainExplanation: A polysaccharide gum produced by fermenting simple sugars with Xanthomonas campestris bacteria.
ingredients.whyUsed: Increases viscosity, suspends herbs/spices in dressings, and stabilizes sauce emulsion.
ingredients.consumerNote: A soluble prebiotic dietary fibre that passes undigested through the upper GI tract. Safe with no ADI limit specified by JECFA.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Approved as GMP stabilizer and thickener under FSSAI regulations.

ingredients.plainExplanation: Natural galactomannan polysaccharide extracted from the seeds of the guar bean plant (cluster bean).
ingredients.whyUsed: Imparts thickness, creaminess, and prevents ice crystallization in frozen desserts.
ingredients.consumerNote: Abundantly grown and milled in India; functions as a soluble dietary fibre.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Recognized GMP natural stabilizer under FSSAI regulations.

ingredients.plainExplanation: Non-fat dry components of fermented, roasted, and crushed cacao beans.
ingredients.whyUsed: Provides authentic chocolate flavour, dark color, and aromatic complexity.
ingredients.consumerNote: Naturally dense in flavanols (polyphenolic antioxidants) which support vascular elasticity.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Specified under FSSAI Cocoa Butter & Chocolate Standards (Regulation 2.7.4).

ingredients.plainExplanation: Pure, edible pale-yellow fat naturally extracted from whole cacao beans.
ingredients.whyUsed: Melts cleanly at human body temperature (34-36°C) for that classic smooth melt-in-mouth chocolate experience.
ingredients.consumerNote: Predominantly composed of stearic, palmitic, and oleic fatty acids. Stearic acid has a neutral impact on LDL blood cholesterol.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Regulated under FSSAI Cocoa Butter Standards (Regulation 2.7.2).

ingredients.plainExplanation: High-purity dairy protein separated from liquid whey during the cheese/paneer curdling process.
ingredients.whyUsed: Delivers concentrated, rapidly absorbed amino acids.
ingredients.consumerNote: One of the highest biological value (BV 104) protein sources known, rich in Branched Chain Amino Acids (BCAA, especially leucine). Contains dairy.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Permitted ingredient under FSSAI Health Supplements and Nutraceuticals Regulations 2022.

ingredients.plainExplanation: A standardized blend of micronutrients added according to national food fortification standards.
ingredients.whyUsed: Restores or elevates essential micronutrient density in staple groceries.
ingredients.consumerNote: In India, certified fortified foods carry the national blue '+F' logo as regulated by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India.
ingredients.fssaiNote: Governed by FSSAI (Fortification of Foods) Regulations 2018.

transparencyFlags.explanation: Label states 'edible vegetable oil' without specifying the specific plant origin (e.g., palm, sunflower, mustard, or soybean).
Label declares generic 'nature identical' or 'artificial' flavouring substances without chemical specificity.
Grouped as 'spices and condiments' without detailing individual botanical proportions.
Colourants listed collectively without individual INS/E numbering.
